messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-07-09] incident-review/INC-2025-017: Incident review INC-2025-017. Auth-gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-07-06. Root cause: an expired intermediate certificate. Decision: certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead, because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.
- [2026-01-27] standup/boreal/2026-01-27: Auth-gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. Rationale: the security audit flagged long-lived tokens.
- [2025-03-06] incident-review/INC-2025-004: INC-2025-004 review. What happened: notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-03-04. Why: a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart. Follow-up decision: notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds, because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes during INC-2025-004.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Reminder: the authentication gateway deploys only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2025-03-11] standup/ember/2025-03-11: Policy: every the auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.
- [2025-06-06] standup/boreal/2025-06-06: Boreal saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-11-05] standup/ember/2025-11-05: Heads-up from Ember: notifier's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.
- [2025-09-18] standup/dune/2025-09-18: The Dune team saw that the flags service's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-20] standup/dune/2026-03-20: Decision: image-resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only, because storage for originals doubled in six months.
- [2025-08-20] standup/cinder/2025-08-20: Decision: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, because feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical. Cinder noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.
- [2025-03-31] standup/boreal/2025-03-31-2: We agreed today that the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. The reason is that the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-02-28] standup/atlas/2025-02-28: Reminder that Ledger only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.
- [2025-11-10] standup/ember/2025-11-10: Heads-up from team Ember: the authentication gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.
- [2025-05-28] standup/dune/2025-05-28: Reminder: the scheduler deploys only on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC.
- [2026-05-05] standup/boreal/2026-05-05: Decided in today's standup: the event-bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16-2: Atlas saw that Ledger's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-08-08] standup/dune/2025-08-08: New deploy window for the job scheduler: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Tuesdays 13:00-15:00 UTC slot. Observation from the Dune team: after the marketing send, billing-api's queue depth hit 50,000.
- [2025-11-17] standup/ember/2025-11-17: Team Ember saw that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it. The weekly architecture review is run by Oskar.
- [2025-09-26] standup/cinder/2025-09-26: The Cinder team saw that the notifier's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-14] standup/ember/2025-04-14: Auth-gateway deploy window: on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: Team Atlas saw that the billing service's error rate crept up to 2 percent following the dependency bump; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-17] standup/cinder/2026-04-17: Observation from the Cinder team: after the runtime upgrade, the authentication gateway's cold start time tripled.
- [2025-12-08] standup/dune/2025-12-08: Tomasz picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today. Team Dune saw that the ledger's p99 latency doubled following Tuesday's deploy; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2025-04-10] standup/boreal/2025-04-10: Team Boreal saw that the catalog service's request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.

Question: Why does certificate expiry alert 30 days ahead?

message.content: Because an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017.

So the reason: an expired intermediate certificate took logins down in INC-2025-017. Answer in one short line with just the reason.
